messages.en: Have you seen the photos of that prince at yesterday's ceremony?
Yeah, I saw them on the palace's official website earlier. His outfit looked amazing!

collocations.en: Her Highness the Princess; Your Highness (in direct address)

messages.en: I want to watch that movie about the princess tonight.
I've already seen it. The story's really good!

senses.en_definition: White; the lightest colour, like that of cotton, and the opposite of black.
Pure, innocent, or honest in character or intention.

messages.en: We have to wear white shirts tomorrow, right? I've only got a cream one.
Yeah, the teacher wants white, not cream. I've got a spare. Want to borrow it?
Yes! Good thing you've got one. I'll pick it up in class tomorrow, okay?
Oh no! Put your stuff in my bag for now.
